notes.summary: GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv (high): node-forge <=1.4.0 RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw; no patched release exists. Reaches the project only via nuxt > @nuxt/nitro-server > nitropack > listhen (dev server self-signed HTTPS), not the prerendered output. npm audit's suggested fix is a downgrade of nuxt to 4.1.3, which is refused.
notes.recheck: has node-forge released a version after 1.4.0? (npm view node-forge version) — then npm audit fix should pick it up via listhen ^1.4.0 range

notes.summary: TS 7 is the native Go compiler and exports no classic JS compiler API (only version + unstable/*); vue-tsc/@volar/typescript (nuxt typecheck) depend on that API, Vue support is planned with TS 7.1. @typescript-eslint 8.72 peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. User decision: stay on ^6 (comment _comment_typescript in package.json).
